info.title: TixWar — Flash Sale Ticketing API
info.description: Backend flash sale ticketing API. Redis stock gate, MongoDB sharded cluster via mongos, outbox and BullMQ saga. Schemas are generated from the Zod contracts in src/modules/schemas.ts and src/modules/docs/models.ts.

post.summary: Create API key (key shown once, stored as hash)

201.description: API key created; apiKey is returned once

get.summary: List own API keys (no raw key)
List events with filters, search, sort, fields, include and pagination

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Allowlist: startsAt, name, createdAt, updatedAt; prefix with - for desc

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor; cannot be combined with page
